tests.exercises: rr, rr+, MrMr and rMr stopping criteria across BiCGStab, CGNE, CGNR, CR and steepest descent in TestStoppingCriteria.
tests.why: Fixed small systems and tolerances determine termination flags, iteration counts and final residuals; these can be compared pointwise without stochastic divergence.

tests.exercises: GMRES Householder/MGS agreement and GMRES/CR agreement on symmetric cases in TestKrylov::test_gmres.
tests.why: Two independent orthogonalization implementations solving the same fixed small systems must agree pointwise; a divergence is deterministic and fault-revealing.

tests.exercises: Oblique, symmetric-oblique, orthogonal, SPD-orthogonal and inexact Krylov method residual/error reduction in TestKrylov::test_krylov.
tests.why: Fixed small systems and reduction-factor thresholds are deterministic; the acceleration probe extends the same code paths to a 300000-unknown sustained workload.

tests.exercises: CG's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends CG's SPD path to a 3-D shipped grid.

tests.exercises: CR's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends CR to a 2-D shipped grid.

tests.exercises: CGNE's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends CGNE's normal-equations path to a genuinely nonsymmetric shipped advection operator.

tests.exercises: CGNR's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends CGNR's normal-residual path to a genuinely nonsymmetric shipped recirculating-flow operator.

tests.exercises: GMRES MGS's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends the MGS orthogonalization path to a 2-D shipped grid.

tests.exercises: GMRES Householder's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends the Householder path to the shipped elasticity (block/BSR-adjacent) operator.

tests.exercises: The top-level gmres() dispatcher's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends the dispatcher to the shipped complex Helmholtz operator, the leaf's only complex-arithmetic path.

tests.exercises: FGMRES's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends FGMRES's flexible Arnoldi bookkeeping to a shipped 3-D unstructured mesh operator.

tests.exercises: BiCGStab's default call path in the parameterized test_defaults case.
tests.why: A fixed 1-D Poisson default call is deterministic; the probe extends BiCGStab to a genuinely nonsymmetric shipped operator for a short window measured to stay stable before its irregular convergence amplifies rounding.

tests.exercises: GMRES MGS and Householder residual-history agreement with scipy.sparse.linalg.gmres across fixed cases in TestScipy.
tests.why: Three independent GMRES implementations solving the same fixed small systems under the same restart/iteration convention must agree pointwise.

tests.exercises: Steepest descent's merit-function monotonicity and AMG-preconditioned convergence in TestSimpleIterations::test_steepest_descent.
tests.why: Fixed dense/SPD cases and a fixed preconditioned system are deterministic; the probe extends steepest descent to a 2-D shipped Poisson grid.

tests.exercises: Minimal residual's merit-function monotonicity and AMG-preconditioned convergence in TestSimpleIterations::test_minimal_residual.
tests.why: Fixed dense/SPD cases and a fixed preconditioned system are deterministic; the probe extends minimal residual to the shipped elasticity operator.
